exposure: Time since previous cesarean section (primiparas, <2 years, 2-4 years, 4-6 years, 6-8 years, 8-10 years, >10 years)
outcome: Immunoexpression of myometrial collagen type VI
Immunoexpression of smooth muscle myosin heavy chain
Expression of clusters of differentiation 31 in the uterine scar
cohort: 177 healthy pregnant women undergoing cesarean section
finding: The immunoconcentration of uterine myometrial scar components remained consistent regardless of the time elapsed since the previous cesarean section, except for alpha-smooth muscle actin which was higher in patients with a shorter interval between cesarean sections.
